Package net.ygbstudio.powerwp4j.models.taxonomies

package net.ygbstudio.powerwp4j.models.taxonomies
Taxonomy helpers for offline analysis.

Defines TaxonomyMarker and TaxonomyValues, used by WPCacheAnalyzer to extract and aggregate taxonomy data (e.g., mapWPClassId workflows described in the README).

0.1.0
